name: 045_tv_ut_bot
hypothesis: TradingView port (PLAN.md section 13), 'UT Bot Alerts' (QuantNomad / Yo_adriiiiaan), one of the most-used scripts on the platform. The author's claim: an ATR trailing stop (key value 1, ATR 10) that ratchets with the close marks the trend, and a close crossing it starts a new trend worth following, long above and short below. Counterparty: traders still positioned for the old trend. Author defaults kept: key 1.0, ATR 10, source close. DEVIATIONS the engine forces: the TradingView version stays in the market and only reverses on the opposite signal; the engine has no stop-and-reverse and every trade must risk 1%, so a pct stop and a time stop are added and are the only grid keys. TradingView's default commission is 0; here it is 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage + funding. Source chart 4h; variants in chart mode (the same bar counts on every chart).
